LESSON: ISLAMIC PHRASES

Grade: Grade 1
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Strand 6
Topic 6.1.3: Islamic phrases

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Islamic phrases. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: when the  Learners in pairs, small groups or pen?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. use the selected Islamic phrases correctly in their daily lives
2. appreciate the importance of using the selected Islamic phrases in their daily lives

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. use the selected Islamic phrases correctly in their daily lives
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to use the selected Islamic phrases correctly in their daily lives. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. appreciate the importance of using the selected Islamic phrases in their daily lives
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to appreciate the importance of using the selected Islamic phrases in their daily lives. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Greet others politely using Islamic greetings you have learned.

Example 2: Keep yourself clean before prayer, just as you wash hands before eating.

Example 3: Share with a friend one good manner you practised today.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Islamic phrases.
2. Explain Islamic phrases to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Islamic phrases.
4. Show that you can: use the selected Islamic phrases correctly in their daily lives
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Islamic phrases. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: when the  Learners in pairs, small groups or pen?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

1. use the selected Islamic phrases correctly in their daily lives
2. appreciate the importance of using the selected Islamic phrases in their daily lives

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.
